content.title: Prudential PLC Shares Rise After India JV Files for IPO Prospectus
content.summary: Prudential  PLC shares rose after the company’s Indian joint venture ICICI Prudential Asset Management filed its initial public offering prospectus with authorities, seizing on an IPO boom in the country.  The fund manager filed a Red Herring Prospectus dated Dec. 6 with the Securities and Exchange Board of India,  BSE  , and the National Stock Exchange of India.  As part of the IPO, Prudential’s subsidiary Prudential Corporation Holdings is selling 9.9% of the stock in ICICI Prudential.
